edges.reason: mint() requires block.timestamp > START_TIME so START_TIME gates minting
block.timestamp is compared against START_TIME, making mint availability timestamp dependent
_amount is multiplied by NFT_PRICE in the price requirement
NFT_PRICE is an operand of the price multiplication
mint() performs the _amount * NFT_PRICE arithmetic
numTokens is added to _amount in the supply check
_amount is added to numTokens and to limit.tokens
mint() computes numTokens + _amount and limit.tokens + _amount
limitsPerAddress is read into the local limit struct
mint() loads and later writes the per-address limit
limit.tokens feeds the addition used for the per-address cap check
mint() calls randomIndex() for each token
randomIndex() return value becomes newTokenId
mint() stores the generated id in the newTokenId local
mint() increments numTokens after each successful mint
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on a contract recipient during mint()
_to is the recipient used by _safeMint inside mint()
block.timestamp is a seed of the keccak256 randomness in randomIndex()
msg.sender is a seed of the keccak256 randomness in randomIndex()
nonce is read as the first randomness seed
indices array is read and written for index selection
randomIndex() computes a miner-influenceable pseudo-random value
randomIndex() computes the remaining size totalSize
randomIndex() derives the raw index local
randomIndex() derives the returned value local
randomIndex() increments the nonce state variable
indices[index] is read to select the token slot
baseTokenURI is concatenated in tokenURI()
_tokenId is validated and encoded in tokenURI()
TOKEN_LIMIT bounds the _tokenId validation in tokenURI()
totalSupply() returns the constant TOKEN_LIMIT
mintOwner() is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner
_to is the recipient used by _safeMint inside mintOwner()
_amount controls the mintOwner() loop and limit update
mintOwner() calls randomIndex() for each token
numTokens is checked against TOKEN_LIMIT in mintOwner()
limitsPerAddress is read and updated in mintOwner()
withdraw() is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner
_to is the destination of the withdraw low-level call
_amount is the value forwarded by withdraw()
withdraw() transfers ETH with a raw low-level call
the call target is attacker-supplied, enabling callback reentrancy
the ETH value sent in the call comes from _amount
transferOwnership() is restricted by onlyOwner
transferOwnership() delegates the state change to _transferOwnership()
newOwner is written into _owner inside _transferOwnership()
_transferOwnership() mutates the privileged _owner state variable
renounceOwnership() is restricted by onlyOwner
renounceOwnership() calls _transferOwnership(address(0))
MAX_MINTS_PER_ADDRESS bounds limit.mints in mint()
MAX_TOKENS_PER_ADDRESS bounds limit.tokens in mint()
_amount drives the mint loop, price check and limit update
newOwner is the argument forwarded by transferOwnership()
the mint() loop is controlled by the i counter

normalization_plan.reason: _to_mint is only consumed as the recipient argument of _safeMint inside mint()
_amount_mint is the parameter multiplied by NFT_PRICE in mint()
_to_mintOwner is only consumed as the recipient argument inside mintOwner()
_amount_mintOwner only drives the mintOwner() loop and limit update
_to_withdraw becomes the target address of the low-level call in withdraw()
_amount_withdraw becomes the value forwarded in the withdraw() call
_tokenId is only used for validation and URI concatenation in tokenURI()
newOwner is assigned directly into _owner inside _transferOwnership()
the limit local is the limitsPerAddress struct read and written by mint()
newTokenId only holds the randomIndex() result used by _safeMint in mint()
i is the loop counter belonging exclusively to the mint() loop
index is the intermediate index computed inside randomIndex()
totalSize is the remaining-supply size computed inside randomIndex()
value is the selected token slot computed and returned by randomIndex()
